notes: All 25 source and 28 target ids partitioned once.
The ASV fronts הַנּוֹתָרִים as *the rest of*, so its units are displaced under rule 25 while the *of* stays with the rectum *family* under rule 19 — the same division as v.61.
The article on הַנּוֹתָרִים takes a plain *the* (rule 15), not a rule 41 supplied pronoun, because the ASV writes none.
